notes.note: Reviewed the static-type repair at bb1e48e5148f1bbcb10375a8aa2626511dcea4d2. The native adapter now calls a fresh visibility predicate before admission, after the awaited permission admission, and on visibilitychange. Both cancellation boundaries and native prepare/discover semantics remain unchanged; the existing descriptions remain accurate. Four focused files/30 tests passed, including real Chromium journal tests and installed Ciao UDP fault cases. Bypassing only the post-admission hidden guard made the new hidden-during-permission test return an incorrect candidate and fail; byte-exact restoration passed all14 adapter tests. UI/scripts/server-tests typechecks passed after the required connect build. Fixture-only Hono option removal, typed browser globals and UDP byte-count callback do not change product contracts. This is review of the named source delta, not renewed physical-device/native artifact, provider or release qualification; B10 permission/discovery/pairing remains pending.
